Having the same issue:
```
Cannot find module '@remix-run/router' from '.yarn/__virtual__/react-router-dom-virtual-d44bda6483/0/cache/react-router-dom-npm-6.4.0-6eb09f3674-5595bb168c.zip/node_modules/react-router-dom/dist/umd'
```

I am using modern yarn. A temporary fix can be to define the dependency manually in a `.yarnrc` file.
```
packageExtensions:
  react-router-dom@*:
    dependencies:
      "@remix-run/router": "*"
```
See https://yarnpkg.com/configuration/yarnrc/#packageExtensions
If someone could make a PR for this, that would be great!

issue.title: fix: [Bug]: react-router-dom does not list dependency @remix-run/router (#9243)
[Bug]: react-router-dom tried to access @remix-run/router, but it isn't declared in its dependencies
issue.body:
### What version of React Router are you using?

6.4.0

### Steps to Reproduce

Require with Yarn pnp which is strict about declaring dependencies.

### Expected Behavior

No issues

### Actual Behavior

Yarn pnp gives:

> react-router-dom tried to access @remix-run/router, but it isn't declared in its dependencies; this makes the require call ambiguous and unsound.

If a package uses a dependency, it must be declared in that package. Providing it via sub-level dep is not correct.

issue.body:
Closes #37489 

Turns out removing the react router features from the references panel is relatively simple with the current changes:

1. References panel internal navigations were already using a custom state variable (https://sourcegraph.com/github.com/sourcegraph/sourcegraph/-/blob/client/web/src/codeintel/ReferencesPanel.tsx?L320-328&subtree=true) so the custom memory state wasn't used for that.
2. The usage inside the Blob view seem _minimal_. After the latest changes from Olaf, we only use it to navigate to an external route which does not need a custom router anyway. And even if we were to change minds, we're already creating a [custom history](https://sourcegraph.com/github.com/sourcegraph/sourcegraph/-/blob/client/web/src/codeintel/ReferencesPanel.tsx?L706-710&subtree=true) inside the references panel only for the blob view. Since this is not using react router API that is at change with the v6 migration, we don't care about this either.

issue.title: [Bug]: Undeclared dependency on @remix-run/router in react-router-dom-v5-compat
issue.body:
### What version of React Router are you using?

```
   "react-router": "5.3.4",
    "react-router-dom": "5.3.4",
    "react-router-dom-v5-compat": "^6.12.0",
```

### Steps to Reproduce

Using yarn pnp, try to use [react-router-dom-v5-compat](https://github.com/remix-run/react-router/tree/main/packages/react-router-dom-v5-compat)


### Expected Behavior

Works

### Actual Behavior

Get an error during webpack build:

```
@formative/main:build:web: ERROR in ../../.yarn/__virtual__/react-router-dom-v5-compat-virtual-82d2bc035e/0/cache/react-router-dom-v5-compat-npm-6.12.0-4c2102b0e2-0a0970956d.zip/node_modules/react-router-dom-v5-compat/dist/umd/react-router-dom-v5-compat.development.js 12:125-153
@formative/main:build:web: Module not found: Error: Can't resolve '@remix-run/router' in '/home/dobes/projects/formative/app.fixups/.yarn/__virtual__/react-router-dom-v5-compat-virtual-82d2bc035e/0/cache/react-router-dom-v5-compat-npm-6.12.0-4c2102b0e2-0a0970956d.zip/node_modules/react-router-dom-v5-compat/dist/umd'
@formative/main:build:web:  @ ../../.yarn/__virtual__/react-router-dom-v5-compat-virtual-82d2bc035e/0/cache/react-router-dom-v5-compat-npm-6.12.0-4c2102b0e2-0a0970956d.zip/node_modules/react-router-dom-v5-compat/dist/main.js 18:2-77
```

### Workaround

Edit `.yarnrc.yml` and add 

```
packageExtensions:
  react-router-dom-v5-compat@^6.12.0:
    dependencies:
      "@remix-run/router": '*'
```
